task.description:
Validate src/design/iss0176-lua07-audit-manifest-hash-minimal-wiring.md for GH-504/ISS-0176 (LUA-07 criterion 2). This design implements a HUMAN-OPERATOR-CONFIRMED scope decision (do not re-litigate whether minimal synthetic wiring is the right call -- that decision was made explicitly outside the pipeline). Your job is to validate the DESIGN's technical correctness and honesty, not the scope decision itself. Verify independently: (1) the design's core claim -- that no engine call site currently invokes the Lua executor -- re-confirm via your own grep of src/engine/ for ScriptResult/executeScript; (2) the EXT-03 plugin-registry rejection reasoning (design section 2.1) -- confirm registerGlobalPluginHandler/registerPluginHandler really are called only from test files, never from src/main.zig or any production bootstrap, by checking yourself; (3) confirm recordExecutionErrorEventInTx (cited as the closest existing precedent for this function's transaction-boundary convention) genuinely exists at the cited location in src/engine/instance.zig with the signature/behavior described; (4) confirm the audit-table schema decision (new dedicated table vs the two rejected alternatives) is well-reasoned against the ACTUAL schemas of audit_entries and audit_log -- read both migration files yourself; (5) confirm the mutation-test design (section 5) is genuinely mutation-checkable as claimed -- would deleting the INSERT or its manifest_hash binding actually make the test fail, or is there a gap in the reasoning; (6) confirm the design's honesty framing (the doc-comment text prescribed for the new function, explicitly stating it is NOT the SERVICE_TASK handler) is precise enough that BACKEND-DEV cannot accidentally under- or over-state what was built when writing the actual code; (7) confirm no implementation code beyond illustrative signatures is present (Type E per templates/lego-catalog.md).

REWORK 1 (completed directly by ORCH, not re-dispatched to CODE-DESIGNER, since both fixes are exactly the single-line-plus-cosmetic corrections the validator itself named precisely, with no remaining ambiguity):
- ISS-0176-DESIGN-REVIEW-1 (MAJOR): line 108's doc-comment text corrected from 'audit_entries' to 'lua_script_execution_audit', matching Sec.3.1/3.2's actual, unchanged, correct table decision.
- ISS-0176-DESIGN-REVIEW-2 (MINOR): illustrative migration filename in the header (line 5) and Sec.3.2 corrected from 'migrations/0NN_iss0176_audit_entries_manifest_hash.sql' to 'migrations/0NN_iss0176_lua_script_execution_audit.sql'.
- Verified via grep: all 7 remaining 'audit_entries' references in the document are legitimate (citing the real, unchanged, existing audit_entries table in rejection/comparison contexts, e.g. 'same convention as audit_entries.actor_id') -- none refer to the new table incorrectly.
- Re-ran python tools/lint_design_artefact.py: exit 0, no issues.
No other change made -- all 5 core technical claims and the mutation-test design were already independently confirmed accurate by this same validation pass.
acceptance_criteria: EXT-03 rejection reasoning independently confirmed against actual call sites
recordExecutionErrorEventInTx precedent confirmed to genuinely exist as cited
Audit-table schema decision confirmed well-reasoned against actual existing schemas
Honesty framing confirmed precise and unambiguous for BACKEND-DEV to implement faithfully
No implementation code beyond illustrative Type E signatures
